description: Band above the prompt: CPA relay quota and usage, plus this session's tokens, cost, cache countdown and model

refreshSeconds.title: CPA refresh interval (seconds)

cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives: 60 as on a Claude subscription, 5 for the API default.

priceMultiplier.description: Your provider's price as a fraction of Anthropic list price (1 = list price).
